meta.title: Certificate Expiry Tracking: refused for a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role
gaps: Certificate Expiry Tracking with staged reminders and auto-block is not represented by any catalog step.
Signing in as both a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role and an MDM / Master Data Team user, including comparing their access, is not supported by the catalog.
Verifying the tenant is on the Enterprise plan is not supported by the catalog.
